correctness.rationale: The first-last interval intersection is equivalent pathwise to completion of all labels followed by the rediscovery of all except the last newcomer. Conditioning on the first-completion time and last newcomer gives the exact nonuniform inclusion-exclusion CDF; iid strong Markov gives the fresh suffix, uniformity gives independent geometric stage durations, and a Bonferroni-controlled coupon-collector limit gives independent Gumbels. Exact moments and integer boundaries follow. Replayed standalone exact checker: 117928 assertions.
